caption: The drawing depicts a pair of rectangular double doors set within a rectangular frame, all illustrated in black ink on a light, cream-colored background. Each door has two panels arranged vertically; the upper panel is taller and the lower panel is shorter. Both the upper and lower panels of each door contain intricate, symmetrical ornamental carvings with swirling and leafy motifs. The doors each feature a round doorknob positioned close to the meeting edge at about average hand height, with small square keyhole plates directly below the knobs. The wood grain texture is emphasized with parallel line work, and the paneling is outlined with shaded edges to suggest depth. Measurement indications are provided, showing the width as 3' 5'' and the height as 8' 4''. There are no colors other than the black ink drawing on the off-white paper.
title: Carved Wooden Door
